Live Minimal Techno & Dark Ambient Console

Click anywhere or press Enter to initialize audio

CONTROLS & SHORTCUTS

4-PANEL WORKSPACE

  • 01 Orbits & Geometry: Click ring to add/remove in-time hits; click Geometry to cycle shape.
  • 02 Percussion: Click/swipe Kick, Perc, Hat, Clap, and Tom steps live.
  • 03 Melody Sketch: Draw curve to quantize (overdubs!); click cell to toggle.
  • 04 Sweeps: Drag = Filter & Space; Alt+Drag = Resonance & Pump.
  • Scroll Wheel: Morph Minimal ↔ Drift.

KEYBOARD SHORTCUTS

  • 1–8: Mute Audio Channels  |  Enter: Play/Stop  |  Tab: Bank
  • WASD + QERF: Context controls for selected component
  • C: Shuffle  |  V: Undo  |  Space / Z / X (Hold): Drop / Tape / Stutter
